roles.why: Clarity about purpose is reported as raising accounting performance directly rather than by moving value from anywhere else, so it adds to the outcome.
Authentic purpose is said to make work meaningful, which creates meaningfulness that was not there.
Meaningfulness is described as routing purpose to performance, and routing here adds rather than conserves: nothing is said to lose what performance gains.
Stoelhorst and Vishwanathan say exposure to shirking is what calls for control rights, so the exposure creates the claim to them rather than moving it from anywhere else.
The other half of the same claim, and it enters the same way: exposure to externalities is a reason the relation needs control rights, not a transfer of rights already held.

quantities.why: How much of what was conceded is left to discretion. A DEGREE and not a share: the two channels divide what was conceded, not the firm, and the page reads every share-kind outcome as partitioning one whole, which is something this model does not say.
Measurement capability is both something a firm accumulates and something reported as how much of it is in place; the corpus does not settle which.
Reported as a survey factor score, measured absolutely rather than against a baseline.
ROA and Tobin's Q are levels; neither is defined against a zero-purpose baseline.
Measured as how much mission is in place, not as a change from any reference point.
What a firm states, read absolutely rather than against what it stated before.

How much of what was conceded is pinned down in advance. Stoelhorst and Vishwanathan record it as a nominal type, naming WHICH party gets control rights; the model needs HOW MUCH, so it is declared a degree and the gap between the two is a declaration rather than something their claim supplies.
They read it as a type a relation either is or is not. The model needs how exposed the relation is, so it is declared a degree with their binary reading at the corners.
The other vulnerability in their two-by-two, declared the same way and for the same reason.
